human.controls: Q (key 4) rotates, W (key 5) moves left, E (key 6) moves right, A (key 7) drops.

reference.name: Octax (Radji 2025, arXiv 2510.01764): JAX CHIP-8 emulator + 22 arcade games with register-read rewards
reference.license: MIT (code); ROMs per-game authorship in each module metadata, four are Octax-modified builds with .8o sources
reference.env: octax/env.py OctaxEnv, constructed as octax/environments/__init__.py create_environment does (disable_delay defaults False there)
reference.step_semantics: press action_set[a] (a == len(action_set) is NOOP); run (700 // 60) * 4 = 44 instructions; timers: zeroed if disable_delay else max(t - 1, 0) in uint8 (0 becomes 255); release the key; reward = score_fn(after) - score_fn(before); terminated = terminated_fn(after); truncated at time >= 4500. Startup instructions run once on PRNGKey(0); reset(rng) then replaces rng with PRNGKey(seed).
reference.parity: full state every step: pc, I, V[0..15], stack pointer, stack[0..15], delay, sound, keypad[0..15], display sha1 (64x32 bools, x-major, packbits), rng key data, score, reward, terminated, truncated; same ROM bytes, seed and action sequence; tests/gate_oracle.mjs vs tests/oracle.py
not_matched: pixels: Octax renders the 64x32 display at 8x (512x256 RGB); PlayTrain draws it 1:1 into the middle band of a 64x64 observation (rows 16..47) and shows a 256x256 canvas to humans, colours from the `classic` scheme only

observation: Octax stacks the display after instruction 11, 22, 33 and 44 of each step (4 frames); PlayTrain observes the display after the step (the 4th of those frames); the stack is recoverable with the runtime's frame_stack=4 in grayscale
the host reset consumes one NOOP frame before the first agent action (PlayTrain draws and steps in the same frame)
termination: PlayTrain stops the episode at gameState GAMEOVER; Octax keeps stepping the terminated state (the lockstep gate compares those steps too)
truncation at 4500 steps is the sidecar's max_steps, enforced by the runtime, not by the game
sound: the sound timer is emulated bit-exactly, nothing is played
two keys held by a human resolve to the lower action index; Octax's action space has one key per action, so the case never arises for an agent
